_note: ADV figures are order-of-magnitude daily dollar volumes in USD millions. They are a declared scenario parameter, not measured data. The cusips map is MANY-TO-ONE: multi-class issuers list every class and they sum into one column. A manager may list several CIKs: Two Sigma Investments (1179392) and Two Sigma Advisers (1478735) file separate 13Fs for the same quarter and both books belong to the same firm, so they are summed into one row.
